Title: IoT Hub private link now works with the built-in Event Hub compatible endpoint

Body.Content:
Starting today, all new IoT Hub private links will support private connectivity to the built-in Event Hub compatible endpoint.

When you create a private link to your IoT hub, you will get two private endpoints: one for the IoT hub APIs and one for the built-in endpoint (with servicebus.windows.net in the FQDN). Existing private links are not updated, so you must create new private links to take advantage of this feature.

To learn more, see our documentation.

For any questions or concerns, reach out throught Microsoft Q&A.
